description: Multi-bot roster + CAS failover. scheduled_publish is a nominal target, not a guaranteed completion time. Follow each bot's platform_cron; per-bot scheduler_lag_compensation_minutes overrides the top-level fallback. Neon triggers at 05:30 with zero compensation, within its claimable interval; Cream retains its early trigger. Early wakes must wait and recheck success instead of exiting. Late wakes apply min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish.

bots.duties: Platform cron 05:30 HKT starts inside the claimable interval. A 20-minute wake delay still leaves 30 minutes before 06:20. Success guard; if missing and remaining until claim_window_end >= min_remaining_minutes_to_start_full_publish (25), CAS claim and full publish. Early wakes wait and recheck; nominal 05:30 is not a guaranteed completion time.

Platform cron 06:00 HKT for nominal 06:20 failover check (lag compensation). CAS claim if today missing within [06:20,06:50) incl. early_skew. Interest-notes sync cron 04:45. Always send check report to maintainer.

last_success.note: Primary publish covering 2026-09-24: RegenHarness, TANDEM and BladeMaster; three original paper figures and two evidence-grounded news/community items.
